accent.note: Brand, never status. Permitted in exactly three placements: active navigation item, primary action, authorized subject.

amber.note: Always accompanied by a mark and a word.

red.note: Always accompanied by a round mark and a named reason.

themes.mechanism: Both themes are first class. The root carries data-theme. With no explicit choice the surface follows prefers-color-scheme; a manual toggle overrides it and the choice persists per viewer.

elevation.policy: No elevation system. Separation is a 1px line in {colors.line}. Cards and panels never float.
appliesTo: agent rail when it overlays below 920px

motion.policy: One authored moment per surface, not scattered effects.
motion.authored-moment: Agent activity rows settle in sequence as each step completes.
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the settle animation entirely; the rows render in place.

breakpoints.full: >= 1241px, three columns, left rail 212px, agent rail 392px
breakpoints.compact: <= 1020px, left rail forced to the 54px icon rail
breakpoints.overlay: <= 920px, agent rail overlays the application instead of sitting beside it

iconography.rule: Authored SVG only. No icon font, no emoji, no unicode glyph standing in for a drawn icon.

browserSurfaces.rule: Surfaces the design did not draw still carry the design.
browserSurfaces.scrollbar: 10px, thumb {colors.line} with a 3px ground-coloured border, transparent track

typographyRules.governing: Prose in Instrument Sans, facts in JetBrains Mono. A fact is a revision, artifact digest, run id, duration, file path, error code, or model id.
typographyRules.floor: Functional text never below 12px. Density comes from spacing, not from shrinking type.
typographyRules.webfonts: Instrument Sans 400/500/600 and JetBrains Mono 400/500, self-hosted in production rather than fetched from a third party.

extensions.northStar: The application is the work. The machine is accountable. Exact truth is always one move away and never in the way.
rules: Colour never carries meaning alone. Every state pairs a mark with a word.
One accent, three placements: active navigation item, primary action, authorized subject.
Separation is a hairline, never a shadow.
A failed run keeps the operator's request visible, verbatim, with the reason named beside it.
The preview surface holds the application edge to edge, with no chrome between operator and work.
donts: Violet, or a purple-to-cyan gradient. The category's tell.
Glass, blur, glow, or a pulsing orb.
Inter for the product interface. It is what the competitor uses and why the earlier prototype read as generic.
An address bar, a status strip under the application, or a context chip above the composer. Removed deliberately on 2026-09-18.
Monospace as a costume. It marks facts and only facts.

declaredDeviations.reason: A preview surface shows the application edge to edge. Insetting it would put chrome between the operator and the work.
Accurate, and the accepted ceiling of a free family. The path past it is licensing a face.
Occurs inside the demonstration application rendered in the preview, which is a different product's interface authored by the agent and correctly not bound by this system.

provenance.method: Seven comparable products inspected live on 2026-09-18 by reading computed styles.
conclusions: Every product with a committed identity commissioned or licensed a face; the two that did not use Inter.
No product in the category uses green, and the pre-existing Conexus CSS was green-grey (#18211d on #f4f6f2).
